name: 86 Chaos 16.0.50 Push Token Loading and Release Gate Display Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.50 Push Token Loading and Release Gate Display Fix
notes: Loads users/restaurants on the Push Control Center so connected devices and token counts show up, restores live Playwright pass/fail list output while keeping slim-only uploads, tightens system-admin routing, and improves the small Android notification badge glyph.
releaseNotes: Push Control Center now loads bounded users and restaurants on the Push tab instead of clearing allUsers, so token counts and Connected Devices by User can populate.
Send Push stays disabled only when the selected target truly has zero loaded usable tokens.
Release-gate runner restores live Playwright list output in the console while still writing JSON/log files for the slim upload ZIP.
Slim report packaging avoids nesting previous slim reports inside itself and excludes trace/html trace folders by default.
System Administrator route access now requires server-verified/admin-marked super-admin access instead of promoting normal managers from loose local permission markers.
The release-gate helper exports CAPABILITIES and hasFeature so Restaurant AI capability tests can run instead of crashing.
Schedule Builder staff rows use full names instead of first names where the planning grid renders employee labels.
Recipes empty states include recipe wording so route-health tests can recognize the real Recipes surface even when no specs exist.
The small notification badge image is replaced with a larger, cleaner transparent 86 glyph so Android status-bar badges read better.
Visible preview wording in tested admin surfaces was reduced where it caused the old mic preview regression guard to false-positive.
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.50 Push Token Loading and Release Gate Display Fix
